selection.name: Death Pulse
selection.description: The caster releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
selection.differences: Deals slightly reduced damage, but has increased radius.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases heal by 35 and reduces cooldown by 2.5s.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Each pulse bounces once on a random target.

selection.name: Death Ward
selection.description: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +100 attack range, +60 attack damage. Hero gains Voodoo Switcheroo.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Death Ward attacks gain True Strike and bounces towards the closest enemy heroes within 650 units of the previous target. Cannot bounce on the same enemy twice.

selection.name: Decay
selection.description: The hero steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as they claim the enemy's strength for themselves.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases strength steal by +6. -1s cooldown.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Decay triggers 2 additional times at the targeted location 3 seconds apart.

selection.name: Demonic Cleanse
selection.description:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

selection.name: Demonic Purge
selection.description:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration. The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Demonic Cleanse (3 charges, costs 50 mana).
